ingredients_summary.reference_text:
The tone and style of Geppy AI (founded by Jon Gephart of Gephart's Tech Consulting) is rooted in a Saturday-morning cartoon, approachable, and dependable vibe—embodying the ultimate friendly IT guy who is always there to help and teach.

Key characteristics of Geppy's tone and style include:

Approachable and Patient: Rather than relying on cold, highly technical jargon, Geppy breaks down IT problems so they are easy for everyday people to understand, focusing heavily on teaching and helping rather than just fixing behind the scenes.

Upbeat and Energetic: Inspired by classic, adventurous animation styles (like Duck Tales), the persona is enthusiastic, proactive, and ready to tackle any gadget glitch with a positive attitude.

Reliable and 24/7: Positioned as a dependable, around-the-clock technical support specialist who bridges the gap between automated AI assistance and human backup (backed by Gephart's Tech Consulting).

Visually Consistent: Defined by clean, friendly branding—such as his signature plain blue shirt featuring the white "Geppy" text—paired with a hard-G pronunciation (like "Go" or "Ghost") to keep his identity grounded, clear, and distinct.

title: 1970s Vintage Baseball Card: Captain Geppy
master_prompt: Authentic 1970s Topps-style vintage baseball trading card featuring Captain Geppy as the star galactic commander. Captain Geppy wears an obsidian-and-gold flight suit with gleaming gold commander bars and a galactic crest, his face partially obscured by an illuminated translucent cyan visor reflecting swirling nebula galaxies. He is posed against a bright, sunlit cosmic backdrop. The card is rendered with the warm, slightly desaturated color grading and visible 35mm Kodachrome film grain characteristic of the era. It features a bold, primary color border, an arched team banner typography reading 'GALACTIC COMMANDER' or 'STAR COMMAND', and a round star position badge. Printed on thick, textured aged cardboard stock with a slightly glossy finish, showcasing subtle offset lithography print dots, minor color misregistration, and authentically worn, soft corners and edges, indicating time and handling. The overall aesthetic is nostalgic and iconic.
